input.summary:
parts/back.mjs (pool, patio and garden details) builds with 177 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; make.sh writes build.nbt.
The fix: kidney_pool's quartz coping is routed through an airOnly view, so its writes onto the patio's already-paved smooth_stone deck cells are skipped, not refused.
No vocab.mjs or other module was edited.

waste.what: Worked out which of the 24 refused writes came from which helper: the report prints only the first 8 (refusedAt.slice(0, 8)), so I had to read kidney_pool's source to see the refusals were its quartz coping.
waste.cost: one report read plus a source read of vocab.mjs kidney_pool; no blocks placed by hand
waste.tool: runParts report that lists every refused cell (not slice 8) and groups them by the helper call or part label that issued the write

waste.what: Hand-wrote an air-only guard Proxy in back.mjs to stop one helper's writes into locked cells, duplicating the view pattern runParts already uses internally.
waste.cost: about 12 lines, one edit, two make.sh runs to confirm refused went to 0
waste.tool: a build-library helper such as g.airOnly() or a per-call option like runParts(...{ skipOccupied: true }) so a part can scope a helper to free cells by name

waste.what: Deciding skip versus move for the coping meant reading kidney_pool internals: the coping is hard-wired into the helper with no flag to omit it or to target only the cells a part does not own.
waste.cost: one source read and one reasoning pass about the deck-cell ownership
waste.tool: kidney_pool(g, { coping: false }) or a coping-cells parameter, plus the plan naming which deck cells the patio owns so the conflict is caught at plan time

left: The quartz coping ring beside the pool (plan element 24) is no longer built: the deck cells at y=0 keep the patio's smooth_stone, so the pool edge reads as stone, not quartz. Restoring it means changing the patio part (an earlier, locked part), which is out of scope here.
The shared vocab.mjs kidney_pool still writes coping blindly; any other part that calls it over paved cells will hit the same refusal.

structured_output.summary:
parts/back.mjs (pool, patio and garden details) builds with 177 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette; make.sh writes build.nbt.
The fix: kidney_pool's quartz coping is routed through an airOnly view, so its writes onto the patio's already-paved smooth_stone deck cells are skipped, not refused.
No vocab.mjs or other module was edited.

waste.what: Worked out which of the 24 refused writes came from which helper: the report prints only the first 8 (refusedAt.slice(0, 8)), so I had to read kidney_pool's source to see the refusals were its quartz coping.
waste.cost: one report read plus a source read of vocab.mjs kidney_pool; no blocks placed by hand
waste.tool: runParts report that lists every refused cell (not slice 8) and groups them by the helper call or part label that issued the write

waste.what: Hand-wrote an air-only guard Proxy in back.mjs to stop one helper's writes into locked cells, duplicating the view pattern runParts already uses internally.
waste.cost: about 12 lines, one edit, two make.sh runs to confirm refused went to 0
waste.tool: a build-library helper such as g.airOnly() or a per-call option like runParts(...{ skipOccupied: true }) so a part can scope a helper to free cells by name

waste.what: Deciding skip versus move for the coping meant reading kidney_pool internals: the coping is hard-wired into the helper with no flag to omit it or to target only the cells a part does not own.
waste.cost: one source read and one reasoning pass about the deck-cell ownership
waste.tool: kidney_pool(g, { coping: false }) or a coping-cells parameter, plus the plan naming which deck cells the patio owns so the conflict is caught at plan time

left: The quartz coping ring beside the pool (plan element 24) is no longer built: the deck cells at y=0 keep the patio's smooth_stone, so the pool edge reads as stone, not quartz. Restoring it means changing the patio part (an earlier, locked part), which is out of scope here.
The shared vocab.mjs kidney_pool still writes coping blindly; any other part that calls it over paved cells will hit the same refusal.
